description: gate-4 remediation: adds evidence_status (externally_sourced / derived_synthesis / unsupported_gap), separating real independent support from reasoned synthesis from an honest, tracked gap. gate-2 parity note still applies: subject_table/subject_id are real DDL columns via three typed join tables (tactic_claim, regulation_provision_claim, species_claim) rather than JSON-only fields with no storage.

source_id.description: Required (non-null) when evidence_status=externally_sourced -- a derived_synthesis claim's real support is its derived_from_claim_ids, not a single source; an unsupported_gap claim has no source at all. A fabricated/placeholder source must never be created merely to satisfy this as a non-null FK.

field_path.description: Exact JSON field path within the subject record this claim supports, e.g. 'equipment.line_test_lb' or 'works_when'.

evidence_type.description: Null only when evidence_status=unsupported_gap -- there is no evidence, so no evidence type applies.

derived_from_claim_ids.description: Required non-empty when evidence_status=derived_synthesis (this claim's ancestry); must be empty for externally_sourced and unsupported_gap claims.

derivation_explanation.description: Required (non-null) when evidence_status=derived_synthesis -- states in plain language HOW the cited claims combine to support this field, so the reasoning is auditable rather than asserted.

allOf.description: gate-4 rule: a derived_synthesis claim may only be LABELED expert_consensus evidence_type if it draws on at least two distinct externally_sourced claims -- enforced structurally here (minItems 2) and cross-checked for actual distinctness/independence by the import validator, which JSON Schema alone cannot verify.
